[[File:Class_Three_lineup.png|thumb|300px|A lineup of third-degree droids]]
{{Quote|I'm only a third-degree 'droid and not very knowledgeable about such things as transatomic physics.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>}}
A '''class three''' or '''third-degree droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programmed for interaction with organic beings in services such as [[Youngling/Legends|child]] care, [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]], interpreting, teaching, and the social sciences. [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] and [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]] were third-degree droids.

Some droids could be equipped with [[protocol chip]]s to give them the cognitive functionality to engage socially.
